limits: Broad protein evidence is not known-truth sensitivity or specificity.
Both arms use exact complete trimmed nucleotide-pair keys for this comparison; the native production duplicate policy also uses alignment coordinates and sequence similarity.
Species summaries use the frozen viral-reference taxonomy, including the original protein LCA, with exact-pair support; they do not establish infection or novel-virus discovery.
NR tiers and both-mate/related subsets are descriptive evidence summaries, not tuned calling thresholds.
